source: 哪吒英文启蒙动画_场景锚点图方案_V1.0.md
style: 2D cel-shaded Chinese mythic fantasy animation, fine dark ink outlines of even weight, flat colour fills with one hard-edged shadow layer, hand-painted watercolour skies, very subtle rice-paper grain, no 3D rendering, no photoreal skin, no lens flare, no chromatic bloom; character designs, colours, proportions and line weight must match the supplied reference sheets exactly.
negative: NEGATIVE: no on-screen text or lettering of any kind, no modern objects, no plastic, no photorealistic skin or 3D render, no lens flare or bloom, no Japanese anime eye sparkles, no extra characters beyond those described, no adult-proportioned child, no full-body dragon, no change to the fixed landmarks of this scene.
smoke_negative: no on-screen text or lettering of any kind, no modern objects, no plastic, no photorealistic skin or 3D render, no lens flare or bloom, no Japanese anime eye sparkles, no extra characters beyond those described, no adult-proportioned child, no full-body dragon, no change to the fixed landmarks of this scene

camera.A: wide establishing shot, eye level, 24mm equivalent, horizon per scene card, static, full depth of field
camera.B: medium shot, 50mm equivalent, subject on the left third, slight background falloff
camera.C: close detail shot, 85mm equivalent, shallow depth of field, object centred, background soft

rules.scene_anchor: empty set, no people, no characters
rules.text: readable text is never generated; plaques, banners, letters and milestones keep an ink block only, lettering added in post
rules.scale: one known-size reference object must be visible in frame
rules.water_axis: in all S04 scenes water stays on the left, shore and people on the right
rules.one_light: S05 has exactly one light source, the hanging pearl

scene.S05-1: coral column 6m, pearl 1.2m at 7m, jade step 0.15m
scene.S06-3: cave mouth 3m, step 0.18m x 1.2m wide, sandal 0.25m
scene.S08-1: offering table 2m wide 1.0m high, threshold 0.35m, tablet 0.3m
scene.S12-1: main flag pole 8m, broken spear 1.4m, mirror 0.6m
scene.S12-2: pillar 4.5m tall 0.8m across, fallen banner 5m, crack 6m
scene.S13-1: boat 6m, pier post 1.4m out of water, lighthouse 5m
scene.SKY-1: cloud platform 3m wide, no ground scale; roof grain conveys height

S01-1.lock: an ancient coastal Chinese fortress gate seen from outside, a three-tier grey gate tower with a slightly crooked dark wooden plaque bearing only an ink block, grey sandstone walls with crenellations, a dark arched gate passage 2.6m high, two stone lions flanking the gate with the left lion missing one ear, a string of exactly seven red paper lanterns along the crenellated wall, one crooked old locust tree leaning east, a rutted ochre dirt road running east and exiting bottom-right, low heavy grey clouds, a flat grey sea only on the far right horizon.
S01-1.light: overcast grey daylight with a cold blue cast, exactly seven lanterns glowing warm against the grey wall, flat sea light on the far right

S01-2.lock: the deep interior of a fortress gate passage, thick grey stone jambs, five worn flagstones under the arch, one red lantern hanging from the centre of the vault as the only warm light, the bright town street visible through the far opening, a single wheel rut in the dirt outside, cool shadow inside against warm daylight beyond.
S01-2.light: cool shadow inside the gate passage, one warm lantern overhead, bright warm daylight beyond, the outside 20% more saturated than the inside

S01-3.cn: 陈塘关·城墙顶与城楼（含锁着的乾坤弓）
S01-3.lock: on top of a grey sandstone fortress wall, crenellations running across the lower fifth of frame, a wooden watchtower with a red railing on the left two-thirds, on its wall bracket a long bow locked with a red cord (a prop that is never taken down or drawn), one missing corner in the third merlon, an open gap on the right looking out to a flat grey sea at 30% of frame height, cold overcast light.
S01-3.light: cold overcast light from above, a warm pool around the lanterns, the far sea flattened into grey-blue haze

S01-4.lock: a narrow ochre dirt road running east into the distance in one-point perspective, low grass and earthen banks on both sides, two deep wheel ruts, a half-buried blank milestone 0.6m high on the left, a wind-bent reed cluster on the right, a pale misty horizon at 55% of frame height, one tiny distant point of light at the end of the road.
S01-4.light: pale misty morning light along the road, one tiny warm point at the far end, no strong shadows

S02-1.lock: a Chinese courtyard mansion's open inner court, grey brick paving in a herringbone pattern running diagonally north-east, six vermilion columns around a covered walkway, a three-step stone stair to the main house at the top third with a worn hollow on the second step, a stone well with rope marks on the rim on the west side, an old plum tree leaning south-east with one empty birdcage hanging in its branches, a bamboo laundry pole on two stands on the east side, a low grey brick wall at the south edge, whitewashed walls, warm late-afternoon sunlight.
S02-1.light: warm late-afternoon sunlight raking across the brick paving at 35 degrees from the west, long soft shadows

S02-2.lock: a covered wooden corridor in a Chinese courtyard mansion in one-point perspective, vermilion columns on both sides at 2.4m spacing with round stone plinths, three red lanterns hanging overhead, paper-lattice windows at the far end, grey brick floor, afternoon light cutting across the corridor in warm bars.
S02-2.light: afternoon light cutting across the corridor in warm bars, the lower half of frame in cool shade

S02-3.lock: the back gate of a courtyard mansion, a heavy ochre wooden door with a new brass lock hanging on the outside at the golden-section point, a low grey brick wall 2m high with a stool left at its foot, two old bolt marks on the door, a narrow lane behind leading to bright light, warm afternoon shade.
S02-3.light: warm afternoon shade on the wall, the brass lock catching one bright highlight, a bright lane beyond the gate

S03-1.lock: a formal Chinese hall interior, dark wooden beams overhead, a long altar table 2.4m wide across the middle of frame, a five-piece celadon tea set on it with two chipped cup rims, two high-backed chairs set symmetrically, a six-panel folding screen behind painted with sea waves and clouds with a crack running through the middle panel, a dark plaque with an ink block on the beam, lattice windows with paper panes, soft indoor daylight.
S03-1.light: soft daylight through paper windows, a warm pool of light around the altar table, beam shadows overhead

S03-2.lock: a Chinese general's study seen from a 35-degree downward angle, a wide desk holding an unrolled paper map with a pale blue sea in its lower-right corner and one thin river line, a vermilion brush resting on the map with wet ink, four paperweights (three white, one black), a bronze lamp on the left, shelves of scrolls along the right edge, slanted daylight from a tall window.
S03-2.light: slanted daylight from a tall window on the upper right plus one warm bronze lamp on the desk

S03-3.lock: the narrow gap behind a folding screen in a formal hall, the silk screen filling the right 60% of frame in soft focus with wave brushstrokes, a 0.6m gap on the left with one corner of red silk hanging inside it, a bright hall beyond and near-total shadow inside the gap, a paper shim under one screen foot.
S03-3.light: bright hall light outside, near-total shadow in the 0.6m gap, one hard edge of light along the screen

S04-1.lock: a wide shallow river mouth at low tide, water filling the lower two-thirds of frame and flowing from back-left to front-right, three black reef rocks in the mid-ground on the left with the largest split by a clean axe-like crack, a sand bar in the middle of the river, wet sand scattered with shells in the foreground, one wind-bent reed cluster on the right, two layers of blue-grey hills on the far bank, horizon at 32% of frame height.

S04-2.lock: an open sandy shore facing east, gentle surf with white foam on the left half, a crescent high-tide line across the sand, a half-buried plank sticking out of the sand, scattered shells, and far in the upper right the silhouette of a grey fortress wall with a single red lantern glowing on it, low warm sky.

S04-3.lock: a small fishing village on the shore, three long drying racks hung with rows of silver fish across the mid-ground with the middle rack missing one cross-beam, two upturned wooden boats with patched hulls on the left, two low stone cottages with thatch roofs on the right, a fishing net hanging by a door, packed sandy earth underfoot, a thin blue strip of sea on the far left.

S05-1.lock: an underwater dragon palace throne hall seen symmetrically, eight coral columns carved with coiling dragons four on each side, a nine-step jade stair rising to a throne of shell and gold whose two armrests end in outward-facing dragon heads, the fifth step cracked, a giant luminous pearl 1.2m across hanging from the dome as the only light source casting one cold cone, two shrimp-guard statues holding halberds flanking the door, a water curtain across the far arch, near-black teal beyond the cone.
S05-1.light: deep blue-green underwater light, one cold cone from the hanging pearl, everything beyond the cone falls into near-black teal

S05-2.lock: a long ascending corridor of an underwater dragon palace, wide jade steps receding upward in a low-angle one-point perspective, coral balustrades and a row of seven hanging water-lamps on each side with the rightmost one dark, a shallow channel cut down the middle of the steps with water running through it, drifting bubbles between the columns, cold blue-green light.
S05-2.light: cold blue-green light, weak lamp glow, the finest light on the middle steps

S06-1.lock: a lotus pool inside a mountain cave temple, a twelve-petal giant white lotus 1.8m across at the centre, seven stone steps descending into the water on the right, steam drifting in layers over the surface, light entering through one natural slot in the rock wall opposite and illuminating only the flower, dark teal shadow around the pool.
S06-1.light: soft warm light from one slot in the rock wall, steam catching it in layers, dark teal shadow around the pool

S06-2.lock: a stone practice platform inside a mountain cave temple, 2.2m wide with two shallow footprint hollows worn into its top, a spear hole in the floor 30cm from its edge, three bronze censers in a row with the middle one shorter, faint cloud-pattern murals on the rock wall, pale gold light entering from behind on the right.
S06-2.light: pale gold cave light entering from behind on the right, long shadows across the stone platform

S06-3.lock: a cave mouth on a cliff facing west, a stone platform outside it, one old pine leaning 30 degrees toward a sea of clouds, a flight of 108 narrow stone steps descending to the right with the seventh step chipped, two stone lanterns flanking the mouth, a pair of new straw sandals left on the platform with their toes pointing outward, bright backlight beyond the mouth and near-black inside.

S06-4.lock: a flat stone clearing behind a mountain temple, ringed by pines, deep radial spear-point scratch marks on the rock floor, three wooden practice posts 1.6m high on the right, one pine with its branches scorched black, short hard noon light.
S06-4.light: short hard noon light, sharp small shadows, scorched pine in silhouette

S06-5.lock: a cliff edge above a three-layered sea of clouds, a flat boulder 1.2m high worn with a shallow hollow on top, cloud banks below, a distant thread of coastline and one tiny warm light in the upper right at 30% of frame height, cold blue high-altitude light with warm cloud rims.
S06-5.light: cold blue high-altitude light with warm cloud rims, one tiny warm light far below on the right

S07-1.lock: a narrow Chinese market street paved with blue flagstones in one-point perspective, cloth awnings on both sides, a candy stall in the left foreground with a straw stand holding three sugar figures (a rabbit, a rooster, a round ball) and four candied-hawthorn skewers, a fish stall with three wooden tubs of live fish, a pottery stall on the right with one earless jar, cloth banners overhead shown only as colour blocks, warm morning light.

S07-2.lock: a tight alley two metres wide ending at a screen wall, three stone steps before the wall, a blank dark rectangular patch at the centre of the wall where a notice once hung, an over-turned fruit basket with fruit rolled to the steps, a water stain on the left wall, two laundry lines overhead, one bright opening behind and shadow inside.
S07-2.light: shadow inside the alley, one bright opening behind, a hard edge of light on the screen wall

S08-1.lock: an ancestral hall interior of three bays, a long offering table 2m wide across the middle with a chipped corner on the lower right, a three-legged censer missing one ear, five rows of ancestral tablets shown only as ink blocks, two candle stands, a high stone threshold 0.35m, one shaft of light from a roof opening falling on the table, deep shadow elsewhere.

T2VA.note: text only, ambient or transition fills

I2VA.role: the image must be exactly the 0.00-second frame, not a scene reference
I2VA.instruction: For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

FL2VA.role: first frame at 0.00 plus last frame at S.SS; same camera, same light, same framing, only the action differs
FL2VA.instruction: How the reference pictures align with the target video — Picture 1 (from Shot 1) aligns with the 0.00-second mark of the target video; Picture 2 (from Shot N) aligns with the S.SS-second mark of the target video.

L2VA.role: the image is the last frame at S.SS; the whole shot converges onto it — used for every episode-end hook
L2VA.instruction: How the reference pictures align with the target video — <Picture 1> (from [Shot N]) aligns with the S.SS-second mark of the target video.

Ref2VA.role: images define <Subject> only, never a frame; six sections required

angle_roles.A: front wide establishing shot — locks layout, horizon and main vertical line; used as I2VA origin and scale check
angle_roles.B: 45-degree medium shot or over-the-shoulder — locks relative positions and depth; used for dialogue and Arc starts
angle_roles.C: 85mm detail close-up — locks props, texture and hook objects; used for L2VA end frames
angle_roles.R: reverse angle, same axis 180 degrees — only where a character turns back; without it the model invents a new location

camera_to_framing.push_in: subject slightly small, 15% margin on all sides
camera_to_framing.pull_out: subject slightly large, keep the info that will be revealed at the edges
camera_to_framing.pan_tilt: the frame holds only the start; the end position must already exist in the same anchor image
camera_to_framing.truck_tracking: subject on the left or right third with empty space ahead
camera_to_framing.arc: start on the 45-degree B angle, never the front A angle
camera_to_framing.static: use A or B with rule-of-thirds, no margin

h3.label_policy: scene three angles = one <Subject>; character sheet = one <Subject>; prop = one <Subject>; only composed shot frames become <Picture N>

conflicts.text: quote-marked text is rendered into the picture; never quote on-screen text, keep ink blocks and the no-lettering negative
conflicts.lip_sync: voiceover shots must state that on-screen lips stay closed
conflicts.beats: max 3 action beats per generation; split longer actions into two segments with their own keyframes

shot_frame_steps: pick base angle A/B/C/R plus state variant, one scene only
place character from the four-view at the scaled height, feet on the ground contact line
rework at 0.35-0.5 strength only, never above 0.8
measure three known dimensions and verify the three fixed landmarks
store as epNNN_sNN.png and log the label in the storyboard
build the last frame from the same anchor image, changing only the action
